checks.describe: deep-dive S1: Cilium eliminates iptables Service chains — zero KUBE-SVC-* rules on the node
checks.run: docker exec cilium-networking-control-plane iptables-save 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'KUBE-SVC' | tr -d ' \n'

checks.describe: deep-dive S2: kubelet delegates pod networking to the Cilium CNI plugin (05-cilium.conflist)
deep-dive S3: the conntrack table has a finite nf_conntrack_max bound on the worker node
deep-dive S6: no kube-proxy DaemonSet — the eBPF datapath replaces netfilter Service handling
checks.run: kubectl --context kind-cilium-networking -n kube-system get ds kube-proxy 2>&1

checks.describe: deep-dive S5: CiliumNetworkPolicy CRD is registered — enables L7/FQDN rules beyond standard NetworkPolicy
checks.run: kubectl --context kind-cilium-networking get crd ciliumnetworkpolicies.cilium.io -o jsonpath='{.metadata.name}' 2>/dev/null

checks.describe: deep-dive S4: Hubble is enabled in the Cilium install — the substrate for L7 flow visibility
